arguments.issue: Did the Refugee Protection Division (SPR) properly consider all credible evidence before finding the claim manifestly not credible?
arguments.claim: The SPR failed to consider all credible and trustworthy evidence before finding the claim manifestly not credible.
arguments.quote: le demandeur soutient que la SPR n'a pas tenu compte de tous les éléments de preuve, dont de la preuve crédible et digne de foi, pour conclure que la demande était manifestement non crédible.

support.ref: Rahaman c Canada (Ministre de la Citoyenneté et de l'Immigration) (CA), 2002 CAF 89, para 51

arguments.weak_spot: The other side may argue the SPR did consider all relevant evidence and found it not credible.

arguments.issue: Did the SPR justify its finding that the applicant was fired for theft rather than political opinion?
arguments.claim: The SPR did not justify why it believed the applicant was fired for theft and not for his political opinions.
arguments.quote: la SPR ne justifie pas pourquoi elle est convaincue que le demandeur a été licencié en raison du vol plutôt qu’en raison de ses opinions politiques.
arguments.weak_spot: The other side may argue the SPR's reasoning was sufficient or based on available evidence.

arguments.issue: Did the SPR improperly rely on personal knowledge rather than objective evidence from the CND?
arguments.claim: The SPR relied on its personal appreciation of the hotel sector in Cuba, not on objective evidence from the CND.
arguments.quote: la SPR s’est appuyé sur son appréciation personnelle du domaine hôtelier à Cuba pour arriver à cette conclusion, sans avoir cité, ni s’être référé à des éléments de preuve objectifs dans le cartable national de documentation [CND].
arguments.weak_spot: The other side may argue the SPR's knowledge was reasonable or that the CND was not relevant.

arguments.issue: Did the SPR fail to consider the applicant's core allegations of persecution for political opposition?
arguments.claim: The SPR ignored the applicant's main allegations of persecution due to opposition to the government, due to a deficient analysis of the evidence.
arguments.quote: la SPR fait abstraction de l’essentiel des allégations du demandeur, soit qu’il a été persécuté par les autorités en raison de son opposition au gouvernement, et ce, en raison d’une analyse déficiente de la preuve au dossier.
arguments.weak_spot: The other side may argue the SPR did consider these allegations but found them not credible.
